outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of breast anatomy plus a classification table, not a plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating circadian phenotypes and study relationships; it is not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental method (luciferase recording setup), not a data plot.

Panel D shows idealized/illustrative sinusoidal curves inside a method-explanation schematic, not real measured data plotted with averages; per skill guidance, illustrative curves in a diagram are schematic, not plots.
Panel E shows an illustrative example heatmap used to explain the correlation analysis concept, not actual data; heatmaps are also exempt from this check even when real.
Panel F contains an idealized illustrative growth-curve line plot used to explain the workflow concept, not real experimental averages; line plots are also exempt from this check.
Panel G contains an idealized illustrative dose-response line plot used to explain the workflow concept, not real experimental data; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel H shows illustrative example heatmap/mutation matrix graphics explaining the genomic analysis workflow, not real data; heatmaps are also exempt from this check.
Panel I shows scatter plots (PCA cluster plot and 3D parameter plot) which inherently display individual data points as dots; scatter plots are exempt/already satisfy the requirement.
